title: Mixed fleet, routing rule B: an all-in-one for the routine panel beside an HPLC for titer (spec section 4.5)
derivation: The all-in-one profile has one stage in group AIO that measures vcd, viability, glucose, lactate, glutamine and ph with a service time of 270 s (A023). The HPLC profile has one stage in group HPLC that measures titer with a service time of 60 s (A028) and the method protein_a_titer. Rule B: a sample visits each listed profile once, in list order, so visit 1 is the all-in-one and visit 2 the HPLC. Instruments are numbered stage by stage and, inside a stage, in list order: the all-in-one has one stage and the HPLC has one, so AN-1 is the all-in-one and AN-2 the HPLC; the HPLC has its method installed at t0, so no setup is ever needed and setup_s is 0 on both. No profile names a transfer on these stages, so the HPLC visit joins its queue at the instant the all-in-one visit ends (transfer 0). No analyte is measured twice: 6 + 1 = 7 results per sample that has no rerun. Rerun probability and lactate production are 0 so that most samples have no rerun; a sample that over-ranges on glutamine (A089) is rerun and is left out of the check.
